task_3.title: Fix CycloneDX SBOM API parameters and dependency inclusion
task_3.description: The 2.12.2 update fixes Conan's CycloneDX 1.4 SBOM helper so callers use the conanfile-based API, can override the generated SBOM name, and can explicitly include build and test dependencies. The default output is also corrected to use a sensible package-derived name while keeping build and test dependencies excluded unless requested.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure that CycloneDX 1.4 SBOM generation uses the intended conanfile-based API, applies a correct default document name, supports a custom SBOM name, and lets users opt in to build and test dependencies without changing the default host-only behavior.

expectation.grounded: The experimental `conan.tools.sbom.cyclonedx_1_4` API should accept a `conanfile` instance and return the generated CycloneDX 1.4 JSON SBOM as a string. It should derive the dependency graph from `conanfile.subgraph`, allow an optional `name` override for the SBOM metadata name, and expose `add_build` and `add_tests` boolean parameters. When no custom name is provided, the default name should come from the root package name and version when available, or fall back to a generic SBOM name. By default, the SBOM should include host-context, non-test dependencies only; build dependencies and test dependencies should appear only when their corresponding flags are enabled.
expectation.conceptual: Generating a CycloneDX SBOM should work through the normal Conan recipe context, produce a correctly named document by default, let users choose a custom document name, and make build and test dependency inclusion an explicit opt-in. Standard usage should continue to describe the main package and its runtime-relevant dependencies unless the caller asks for broader coverage.

constraints.grounded: The update must preserve CycloneDX 1.4 JSON SBOM generation and its string return value while correcting the public parameter contract. Default behavior must not start including build or test dependencies implicitly, and SBOM generation should still succeed even when the root reference lacks package identity information by using a generic default name.
constraints.conceptual: The fix should broaden configurability without changing the default scope unexpectedly. Existing consumers should still get a valid SBOM for the main dependency set, and missing package identity should not prevent SBOM creation.

behavior: `cyclonedx_1_4` now operates on a `conanfile` input instead of requiring callers to pass the dependency graph directly.
The generated SBOM metadata name can be customized through the optional `name` parameter.
When no custom name is provided, the default SBOM name is derived from the root package name and version when available, otherwise a generic fallback name is used.
By default, the SBOM includes host-context components and excludes build-context and test components.
Setting `add_build` includes build dependencies in the generated SBOM.
Setting `add_tests` includes test dependencies in the generated SBOM.
acceptance_criteria: When a caller generates a CycloneDX 1.4 SBOM through `cyclonedx_1_4(conanfile)`, it should return a JSON SBOM string without requiring direct graph access from the caller.
When the root package has a name and version and no custom SBOM name is supplied, the generated document should use that package identity as the default name.
When a custom `name` is supplied, the generated SBOM should use that name instead of the default derived name.
When `add_build` is not enabled, build dependencies should be absent from the generated SBOM; when it is enabled, build dependencies should be included.
When `add_tests` is not enabled, test dependencies should be absent from the generated SBOM; when it is enabled, test dependencies should be included.
When the root package identity is incomplete or unavailable, SBOM generation should still succeed and use a generic default name.

task_2.title: Fix CycloneDX SBOM filtering and naming options
task_2.description: Conan 2.12.2 fixes the experimental CycloneDX 1.4 SBOM generator so it is invoked from the conanfile entry point, supports explicit inclusion of build and test dependencies, and uses corrected default naming with an optional custom name override.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure that CycloneDX 1.4 SBOM generation exposes the intended public parameters for naming and dependency inclusion, and that the generated document includes only the dependency contexts the caller requested.

expectation.grounded: The public CycloneDX helper `cyclonedx_1_4` should accept a `conanfile` plus optional `name`, `add_build`, and `add_tests` parameters. It should generate the SBOM from `conanfile.subgraph`. By default, the generated document should contain host-context, non-test components only, and its dependency relationships should be filtered the same way. When requested, build-context dependencies and test dependencies should be included. The metadata name should default to the root package name and version when available, fall back to a generic SBOM name otherwise, and allow a caller-supplied `name` to override that default.
expectation.conceptual: Users generating a CycloneDX 1.4 SBOM should be able to choose whether build-time and test-only dependencies appear in the document. Without those options, the SBOM should describe only the normal host dependency set. The SBOM should also use a sensible default document name and let callers replace it with their own name.

constraints.grounded: Do not regress default host dependency reporting. Do not include build-context packages unless `add_build` is enabled. Do not include test dependencies unless `add_tests` is enabled. Apply the same inclusion rules to both the component list and dependency references. Preserve SBOM generation when the root package reference is incomplete by using the fallback default name.
constraints.conceptual: The update must narrow or expand SBOM contents only according to the caller's selected options, while keeping the default output stable for ordinary host dependencies and still producing a valid document when package identity metadata is incomplete.

behavior: `cyclonedx_1_4` now takes a `conanfile` entry point rather than a dependency graph argument.
The SBOM is generated from the `conanfile` subgraph.
By default, build-context dependencies are excluded from the generated CycloneDX component list.
By default, test dependencies are excluded from the generated CycloneDX component list.
When `add_build` is enabled, build-context dependencies are included in both components and dependency relationships.
When `add_tests` is enabled, test dependencies are included in both components and dependency relationships.
Dependency references in the SBOM are filtered using the same build/test inclusion rules as the component list.
The default SBOM metadata name is derived from the root package identity when available, otherwise it falls back to a generic Conan SBOM name.
A caller can provide a custom `name` for the SBOM metadata.
acceptance_criteria: When a caller generates a CycloneDX 1.4 SBOM without optional flags, it should include only host-context, non-test dependencies in the document.
When `add_build` is not enabled, build dependencies should be absent from both the SBOM component list and any dependency references.
When `add_tests` is not enabled, test dependencies should be absent from both the SBOM component list and any dependency references.
When `add_build` is enabled, build-context dependencies should appear in the generated SBOM and in any relevant dependency relationships.
When `add_tests` is enabled, test dependencies should appear in the generated SBOM and in any relevant dependency relationships.
When a dependency is excluded by the selected options, no remaining component should reference it as a dependency in the SBOM.
When the root package has a name and version, the generated SBOM should use that identity as its default metadata name.
When the root package identity is unavailable, the generated SBOM should still use a generic default metadata name.
When a custom `name` is provided, the generated SBOM should use that custom metadata name.

task_1.title: Fix CycloneDX SBOM naming and dependency scope controls
task_1.description: The CycloneDX 1.4 SBOM helper was corrected to use the Conanfile as its input, support an optional custom top-level component name, and expose explicit flags for including build and test dependencies. The generated SBOM now uses a stable default name derived from the package reference when possible and keeps build and test dependencies opt-in.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure that CycloneDX 1.4 SBOM generation uses the corrected helper interface, assigns a predictable default top-level component name, allows callers to override that name, and includes build or test dependencies only when explicitly requested.

expectation.grounded: `cyclonedx_1_4` should accept a `conanfile` plus optional `name`, `add_build`, and `add_tests` arguments. It should generate the SBOM from `conanfile.subgraph`, use the provided `name` for the metadata component when one is supplied, otherwise default that name to the root package reference name with an appended version when available or `conan-sbom` when no root name exists. Host dependencies should be included by default, build-context dependencies only when `add_build=True`, and test dependencies only when `add_tests=True`.
expectation.conceptual: When users generate a CycloneDX SBOM, the document should identify the project with a sensible default name, allow an explicit custom name, and let users opt into build and test dependency coverage without changing the normal host-only output.

constraints.grounded: CycloneDX 1.4 JSON generation should remain available without requiring extra arguments. The default invocation should not broaden dependency scope beyond host dependencies, should not emit an empty top-level component name, and should continue to produce an SBOM document while preserving existing host dependency inclusion.
constraints.conceptual: Default SBOM generation should stay usable out of the box, should not silently add extra dependency categories, and should always produce a meaningful project identity in the generated document.

behavior: `cyclonedx_1_4` now takes a Conanfile object and derives the dependency graph from it.
The generated SBOM metadata component name uses an explicit `name` argument when one is provided.
Without a custom `name`, the metadata component name defaults to the root package name and appends the root version when available.
If no root package name is available, the metadata component name falls back to `conan-sbom`.
Build-context dependencies are omitted from the SBOM unless `add_build` is enabled.
Test dependencies are omitted from the SBOM unless `add_tests` is enabled.
Host-context dependencies remain included in the generated SBOM by default.
acceptance_criteria: When `cyclonedx_1_4` is called with a Conanfile and no optional flags, it should generate a CycloneDX 1.4 JSON SBOM from the Conanfile's host dependency graph.
When a caller provides `name`, the generated SBOM should use that value as the top-level metadata component name.
When no custom `name` is provided and the root package has both a name and version, the generated SBOM should default the top-level metadata component name to the package name plus version.
When no custom `name` is provided and the root package has a name but no version, the generated SBOM should default the top-level metadata component name to the package name alone.
When no custom `name` is provided and the root package has no package name, the generated SBOM should default the top-level metadata component name to `conan-sbom`.
When `add_build` is not enabled, build dependencies should be excluded from the generated SBOM; when `add_build` is enabled, build dependencies should be included.
When `add_tests` is not enabled, test dependencies should be excluded from the generated SBOM; when `add_tests` is enabled, test dependencies should be included.
